brand.name: Kia
brand.description: South Korean carmaker and part of Hyundai Motor Group. Kia India began sales in 2019 and builds cars at its plant in Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh. Its range covers compact and mid-size SUVs, MPVs and electric vehicles.
